records.claim: Discontinue APIDRA, monitor and treat if indicated. ( 5.6 ) Fluid Retention and Heart Failure Can Occur with Concomitant Use of Thiazolidinediones (TZDs): Observe for signs and symptoms of heart failure; consider dosage reduction or discontinuation of TZD if heart failure occurs. ( 5.7 ) Hyperglycemia and Ketoacidosis Due to Insulin Pump Device Malfunction: Monitor glucose and administer APIDRA by subcutaneous injection if pump malfunction occurs. ( 5.8 )
